confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live menus, hotel or hostel listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation, especially hostel private rooms and 3-star hotels, has the widest range because July is high season. Cocktail (about 2.8x beer) and wine_glass (about 2.5x beer) rely partly on the beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: 0.6961 (13 Oct 2026) is the latest RBA-attributed figure I found, but it comes from a search summary that attributes it to the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open that page, and a second search could not corroborate it, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates reflect general knowledge of Colombian Caribbean coastal tourism pricing, with tourist-facing prices reflecting the Walled City and Getsemani premium and July treated as high season. Assumes roughly 4,000 COP per USD.
